notification_title: Electrical Wiring Installations Quality Control Order, 2023
mandate_text: All electrical wiring installations in commercial and residential buildings shall conform to IS 732:2019 and carry mandatory BIS ISI Mark (CM/L number). Non-compliant installations shall be prohibited from use in government-funded procurement.
exemptions: Low-voltage temporary installations below 50V AC are exempt.

notification_title: Medical Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order, 2022
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
mandate_text: Medical electrical equipment imported or manufactured in India must comply with IS 13450:2024 (Part 1) for basic safety and essential performance. Mandatory BIS ISI certification required before commercial sale or procurement by government hospitals.
exemptions: Equipment for personal research purposes is exempt pending separate notification.

notification_title: LED Street Lighting Quality Control Order, 2021
issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
mandate_text: LED street lighting luminaires procured by municipal bodies, PWD, and smart city projects must mandatorily carry the BIS ISI Mark under IS 16107 (Part 2/Sec 2):2017. Procurement of non-certified luminaires is prohibited.
exemptions: Prototype samples for testing purposes are exempt for a period of 6 months.

notification_title: Lamp Controlgear Safety Quality Control Order, 2024
issuing_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
mandate_text: All lamp controlgear including LED drivers, ballasts, and power supplies sold or procured in India must comply with IS 15885:2012 and carry a BIS CRS registration (R-number). Mandatory for all government tenders involving lighting infrastructure.
exemptions: Controlgear rated below 1W for decorative purposes only is exempt.

issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
mandate_text: Luminaires for general lighting purposes supplied to government procurement agencies must carry mandatory BIS ISI Mark under IS 10322 Part 5:2012. All tenders for office, institutional, and industrial lighting must reference this standard.
exemptions: Decorative lighting and artistic fixtures are exempt.

notification_title: Hot Rolled Steel Flat Products Quality Control Order, 2019
mandate_text: Hot rolled steel flat products including plates, sheets, and strips used in structural applications must comply with IS 2062 and carry BIS ISI Mark before use in government infrastructure projects.
exemptions: Steel used for artistic or decorative non-structural purposes is exempt.

notification_title: Threaded Fasteners Technical Supply Conditions Quality Control Order, 2023
issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
mandate_text: All threaded fasteners (bolts, nuts, screws, washers) used in government construction and infrastructure projects must conform to IS 1367 and carry BIS ISI certification. Non-certified fasteners are prohibited in safety-critical applications.
exemptions: Fasteners below M3 size for electronic assemblies are exempt.

notification_title: Pipe Fittings for Plumbing Quality Control Order, 2024
mandate_text: All CPVC pipe fittings used in domestic water supply systems under Jal Jeevan Mission procurement must carry BIS ISI Mark under IS 14971. Mandatory for all Har Ghar Jal tenders.
exemptions: Industrial and drainage fittings are covered under a separate notification.

notification_title: PVC Insulated Cables Quality Control Order, 2022
mandate_text: PVC insulated cables and wires for electricity supply used in government buildings, infrastructure, and grid projects must carry BIS ISI Mark under IS 1554. Procurement without certification is prohibited.
exemptions: Temporary event wiring and testing cables are exempt.

notification_title: Steel Tubes for Structural Purposes Quality Control Order, 2021
mandate_text: Steel tubes for structural purposes procured for use in government construction projects must conform to IS 9537 and carry mandatory BIS ISI Mark. Applicable to all PWD, CPWD, and Defence Estate projects.
exemptions: Tubes for mechanical conveyance (fluids) are covered under separate IS standards.
